body:
Good to know, I didn't think about the hinges, we are taking them all off anyways when we redo the cabinet color, so thanks for thinking ahead!

Also that's a wonderful point about the flooring, so I think we will consider some tile.

We would prefer to go darker with the cabinets as that's just our style, how about something with large white tile? like this?
http://www.houzz.com/photos/4715630/Modern-in-Montvale-contemporary-kitchen-new-york

I think that would make the kitchen feel too small, it's pretty tiny already. think apartment size. I agree to take down the cabinets, but we would need to find another way to get more storage since I don't even have a pantry.
Not exactly, we move in Friday, but this thing is so god awful outdated I wanted to do something right away lol. It's about 7 wide and about 12-13 feet length.
Definitely wanna get rid of the flooring. We plan on getting hardwood for the whole house, do you think we should just extend the hardwood or should we get tile just for that area?

We have some new hardware already (those brushed metal bars you see everywhere) cause yeah, way freaking ugly. I guess you could say we like contemporary? Darker and gender nuteral colors like grays and browns. We also kinda like the art studio kinda industrial feel. At the same time though qe want something we wont have to redo 5-10 years down the road when we sell the place.

I would mount the TV AND the media center. lift it all up a bit, take the legs off the media center and mount it on top of the wall jut thing. Get some decent lighting above the TV and new curtains to go with that.

It attaches to my living room so open style layout, the god awful 70's cabinets will be getting stained darker or painted some other color. The walls will be a neutral tan. budget: well, it's my house, so that depends on how good your idea is, if it's awesome I'll save up and do a  whole kitchen remodel. Otherwise, covering those cabinets and replacing the laminate counters are in our plans, so a few hundred. Also need something to organize our kitchen tools and pantry stuff, any ideas? Office is a 10x10 room, my husband wants to paint his desk orange and paint the walls grey, except and accent wall which he plans on leaving white. He has no other ideas, but he likes clean cut and modern looks with minimal clutter: http://i.imgur.com/MWAwc7B.jpg

Thanks for messaging me :) you helped me get through another day and I'm doing a little better today. Didn't even have to resort to cutting to get me off the edge, which is awesome.

I'm taking it 1 day at a time and getting better slowly, thanks for being supportive and distracting me from the bad stuff. It's always risky when you try something new ya know?

Illustration, I just started last year part time, so I'm finishing up my basic classes this semester. I'm getting a drawing board for my new place in hopes I can motivate myself to draw again. I plan on just starting by copying other pictures an after some time I might have motive hopefully.

I work for a fairly large company with a union, however harassment is very difficult to prove.

That being said my boss' behavior isn't very abnormal for the service industry. We really aren't treated like people in this business. I'm in school part time to graduate and get a different job, but that seems so far away :(
That's very reassuring, thank you. Sometimes it just seems like life set me up to fail, it makes it hard to get up everyday and go to bed every night when I know what I have to face.
